en: I am / You are / He/She/It is / We are / They are
example: I am happy. / She is a teacher. / They are students.

zh: 表示经常发生的动作或事实
example: I eat breakfast every day. / She reads books.
I am reading now. / They are playing football.
I was tired yesterday. / They were at school.
I walked to school. / She went home.

zh: 表示将来的动作或预测
example: I will call you tomorrow. / It will rain.

zh: 表示有计划或将发生的事
example: I am going to visit my grandma.

zh: 表示过去发生且与现在相关的动作
example: I have finished my homework. / She has been to London.
Tom is taller than Jerry. / This book is more interesting.
She is the fastest runner. / This is the most beautiful flower.
a book, an apple, the sun

en: in, on, under, behind, next to, between
example: The cat is on the table. / The ball is under the chair.
at 5 o'clock, on Monday, in June
I can swim. / Can you help me?
You must stop. / You should study.

en: my, your, his, her, its, our, their
example: This is my book. / Where is your bag?

en: what, where, when, why, who, how
example: What is your name? / Where do you live?

en: There is + singular. There are + plural.
example: There is a cat. / There are three cats.

en: Countable: a/an, many, few. Uncountable: much, little.
example: many apples, much water, few books, little time

en: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
example: I always brush my teeth. / She sometimes walks to school.
Open the door. / Please sit down. / Don't run.
If it rains, I will stay home.
Swimming is fun. / I like reading.

zh: 与现在事实相反的假设
example: If I had money, I would travel.

en: If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
zh: 与过去事实相反的假设
example: If I had studied, I would have passed.
The book is read by many people.
The letter was written yesterday.
The work will be finished soon.

zh: 从过去持续到现在的动作
example: I have been waiting for an hour.
She had already left when I arrived.

zh: 过去某个时间正在进行的动作
example: I was watching TV at 8 PM.

zh: 将来某个时间正在进行的动作
example: I will be flying to Paris at this time tomorrow.

zh: 将来某个时间之前完成的动作
example: I will have finished the report by Friday.
The girl who is singing is my sister.

en: Defining (essential) vs Non-defining (extra info with commas)
zh: 限定性/非限定性定语从句
example: My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.
She said (that) she was tired.
He asked if I liked coffee.
She told me to be quiet.
I had my hair cut yesterday.
I wish I knew the answer.

en: I wish + past perfect (regret about past)
example: I wish I had studied harder.
I used to play the piano when I was young.

rule: Be used to / Get used to
example: I am used to getting up early.

en: so + adj + that / such + noun + that
example: It was so hot that we stayed inside.

en: too + adj + to + verb / adj + enough + to + verb
example: The box is too heavy to carry. / She is old enough to drive.
Neither Jim nor Tom was there.
Both of my parents are teachers.
Each student has a book. / Every student likes the teacher.
There is some milk. / Is there any sugar? / There is no water.
Someone is at the door. / I have nothing to say.

en: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
example: I hurt myself. / She taught herself English.
They love each other.
This is my book. / Those are yours.
a beautiful big old round red Chinese wooden table
I am bored. / The movie is boring.

en: be, seem, appear, look, feel, taste, smell, sound, become
example: The food smells good. / She looks happy.

en: verb + particle, object can go between
example: Turn off the light. / Turn the light off.
I ran into an old friend.
To travel is my dream. / I want to learn.
It is important to study.
I enjoy reading. / I want to go.
Thank you for helping me.
You can improve by practicing daily.

en: although + clause; despite/in spite of + noun/gerund
example: Although it rained, we went out. / Despite the rain, we went out.

en: because + clause; because of/due to + noun
example: We stayed because it was raining. / Due to the rain, we stayed.

en: so that + clause (purpose); in order to + verb
example: I studied hard so that I could pass.

en: unless = if not; as long as/provided that = only if
example: You won't pass unless you study.

en: Positive statement, negative tag? / Negative statement, positive tag?
example: You are a student, aren't you?

en: Can you tell me + question word + statement
example: Can you tell me where the station is?
Never have I seen such a beautiful view.

en: Had I known / Were I you / Should you need
example: Had I known, I would have come earlier.

en: It is/was + emphasized part + that + rest
example: It was yesterday that I met her.
What I need is a good rest.
I don't know whether he will come.

en: Omitting words when meaning is clear
example: She can swim better than I (can).

en: It is essential/vital/important that + subject + (should) + verb
example: It is essential that you be on time.

en: one, two, three, hundred, thousand, million
example: I have three apples. / There are one hundred students.
She is the first in class. / It is my tenth birthday.

en: 1/2 = a half, 0.5 = zero point five, 50% = fifty percent
example: Half of the students are girls.

en: on + date, in + month/year, at + time
example: on March 5th, in 2024, at 3 o'clock

en: Capitalize: first word, proper nouns, I, days, months
example: I went to Paris on Monday.

en: . for end, , for pause, ? for question
example: Hello. How are you? I am fine, thanks.
She said, "Hello." / It's John's book.
Your book is on the table. / You're so kind.
The cat licked its paw. / It's raining outside.
There is a book. / Their house is big. / They're happy.
